heading: Art. 131g. Wrongful interference with adverse administrative proceeding
lead: Any person subject to this chapter who, having reason to believe that an adverse administrative proceeding is pending against any person subject to this chapter, wrongfully acts with the intent— shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

tree.text: to influence, impede, or obstruct the conduct of the proceeding; or
otherwise to obstruct the due administration of justice;

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective on Jan. 1, 2019, as designated by the President, with implementing regulations and provisions relating to applicability to various situations, see section 5542 of Pub. L. 114–328 and Ex. Ord. No. 13825, set out as notes under section 801 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 114–328, div. E, title LX, § 5449, Dec. 23, 2016, 130 Stat. 2957.)
